connector.name: DMARKOFF - DMARC, SPF & DKIM Analytics
connector.registryDescription: DMARC analytics for AI assistants - domain health, SPF/DKIM records, compliance stats, anomalies.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.dmarkoff.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.dmarkoff. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: DMARKOFF API key in the format 'Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'. Get yours at app.dmarkoff.com/account/mcp
